# P01 — Recreate the prototype navigation and visual shell

Status: **complete** (local automated acceptance). October 24, 2026, Asia/Manila.

## Scope and delivered behavior

Read BUILD-CONTRACT.md, STATE.md, P00 contracts/code, specification Section 4, F25 and section 11 branding. Inspected the supplied demo's locally cached HTML. Applied skill-router, ponytail, frontend-design and existing React/browser testing guidance. P00 prerequisites available. No model switch or agents.

- `src/app/AppShell.tsx`: sidebar/header, labeled mobile navigation and More, skip/main landmark, visible focus, route-change main focus and polite pending-route state. More focuses Close; Escape restores trigger. Ordinary text identity explicitly labels the pending approved logo.
- `src/app/navigation.ts`: explicit setup/core/guest audience and capabilities; presentation filtering only, never authorization. MEAn does not influence this interface.
- `src/styles/tokens.css`, `global.css`, `DESIGN.md`: Karla, neutral surfaces, compact panels, red focus/active state, responsive wrapping and 44px controls. Replace P00 `src/styles.css`; `src/main.tsx` imports these and locally bundled Karla. Fontsource 5.3.0 added to package/lockfile.
- `src/components/Page.tsx`, `FeedbackState.tsx`, `TextField.tsx`: reusable named page/panel/loading/empty/error/field patterns, associated labels/hints/errors and explicit recovery actions.
- `src/app/router.tsx`: setup overview and explicit unconnected destinations; root/destination/not-found recovery. No business feature pages, fake metrics, simulated success or data requests.
- Shell/navigation/router tests, `scripts/verify-p01.cjs` and scoped CommonJS browser-harness ESLint support. `docs/build/CONTRACTS.md` documents owned interfaces. Original plan/prompt pack unchanged.

Retained failure ledger: first loading assertion expected “Loading” instead of actual “Opening workspace page”; corrected assertion, then all tests passed. Post-test typecheck rejected Testing Library `exact` query options (supported by Playwright only); removed, typecheck passed. First browser-harness lint rejected CommonJS/globals; narrow scripts config fixed it, lint passed. Native Edge preference-based zoom experiment left viewport/DPR unchanged and was not counted as verification. Final zoom check uses explicit emulation. Early mobile screenshots split Deliverables midword; adjusted columns/padding, rebuilt and reran browser assertions.

## Acceptance evidence

- **P01_A1 — passed by automated checks:** 320px/640px have no horizontal overflow; first Tab reaches skip, Enter focuses main; computed focus outline 3px. More open/Escape/route focus passed. 200% zoom reflow emulated as 640×450 CSS pixels at DPR 2 for a 1280×900 display, including keyboard skip/main. Native toolbar zoom and human screen-reader UAT were not exercised.
- **P01_A2 — passed:** mobile controls at both widths at least 44×44px and meaningfully named. Explicitly fictional long person/unit labels injected only into test DOM wrap at 320px; Account retains name/target. Unit test verifies long field labels with required text and hint/error association. Guest navigation remains scoped despite unrelated capabilities.
- **P01_A3 — passed:** thrown root render error yields safe generic message and return link, no internal diagnostics. Pending route announces/clears status. Built root/deliverables/synergy/FIN/admin pages show setup/unconnected states, no fake success actions or synthetic metrics. Unknown route recovers. Filtering confers no data authority.

Evidence: `docs/build/evidence/P01-browser.json`, P01-desktop.png, P01-mobile.png, P01-long-labels.png and P01-zoom-200.png. Screenshots visually inspected; long-label fixtures are test evidence only.
